d: A woman with a background in television journalism and the technology business has become the centre of an extraordinary national security controversy involving one of the world's most powerful technology executives. Her name is Alice Huang, also known as Huang Le. US intelligence officials reportedly suspect that she was recruited by China's Ministry of State Security, or MSS, to get close to Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, gather information and potentially influence the company's business dealings with Chinese firms.
